item.title: Reader Q&A: ask our fashion editor Jess Cartner-Morley your questions now
item.summary: Jess Cartner-Morley has been the Guardian’s fashion editor since 2000 and will be joining us at 3pm BST to answer your questions about her career on the front row Sign in or create your Guardian account to ask a question and join the discussion What’s changed in the industry since 2000, have there been any catwalk disasters, and can you really consume fashion ethically? As Jess gears up for another round of fashion weeks beginning in New York next month, ask her anything about her years covering fashion. Continue reading...
